name: MVGS_CS_MV_CONSENT_DOMAIN
title: MV-GenomSeq consent domains
description: Modules of the MV-GenomSeq declaration of participation (BfArM KDK/GRZ mvConsent.scope[].domain). The MII consent policy CodeSystem (urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.24.5.3) has no concept for them (DISCUSS-TD #35); placeholder until codes are registered.

concept.definition: Participation in the Modellvorhaben Genomsequenzierung (§ 64e SGB V) including sequencing and data processing.
Re-identification of the patient, e.g. to return new clinically relevant findings.
Identification of the case across submissions / data centres (case linkage).
